Author: Rayla Valdez
Name: ClickToMove
Punchline: Shift-click the world to walk there.
Description: Click to move for FFXIV. Hold Shift and left-click ground to move there. Uses vnavmesh pathfinding when available, straight line fallback otherwise. Movement idea adapted from Jaksuhn ffxiv-bundleoftweaks (BSD-3-Clause). Requires vnavmesh for pathfinding: https://puni.sh/api/repository/veyn
